caption: Cell (D1, F1) holds r, so a process in D1 may read F1 — one cell answers one access question. The five grey cells are empty, so a real store keeps only the seven non-empty ones, as access lists or capability lists.

spec.title: Access matrix: rows D1 to D3 are domains, columns F1 to F4 are objects
spec.aria: A three by four grid: domain D1 has read on object F1, read-write on F2 and execute on F4; D2 has read on F2 and read-write on F3; D3 has read on F1 and read-write on F4. The cell D1-F1 is highlighted to show one access question, and the five empty cells are shown grey against seven non-empty cells.
